Container.Name: signal-api
Container.Overview: signal-cli-rest-api, preconfigured as the backend for Signal Web: json-rpc-native mode with manual receive, so messages stay queued on Signal's servers while Signal Web is restarting. No port is published; only containers on the "signal" network can reach it.
Container.Requires: Custom Docker network "signal" (docker network create signal).

Config.Name: Signal data
Config.Description: Signal account keys and state. Back this up; losing it means re-linking.

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: Must be json-rpc-native (or json-rpc) for Signal Web.

Config.Name: Receive mode
Config.Description: manual = only fetch messages while Signal Web is connected, so none are lost during restarts.

Config.Name: Trust new identities
Config.Description: What to do when a contact's safety number changes.
